newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: EEI Jan-Mar net lower at 45.9 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: EEI Jan-Mar net lower at 45.9 mln pesos.

text.p: EEI Corp, the construction arm of House of Investments, said on Friday its net profit in the first quarter of 1997 fell to 45.9 million pesos from a year-ago's 50.4 million.
"Scheduled changes in the implementation of some of its contracts kept EEI's income from rising as expected, but its construction backlog remains robust," the company said in an statement.
EEI said its construction backlog reached 6.8 billion pesos for the first quarter of the year, up from 3.7 billion pesos for the same period in 1996.
The company recently won contracts to construct the RCBC Plaza and the Philamlife Tower projects in the financial district of Makati and the Metro Rail Transit project along a main highway in Manila.
